input_authority.source_parameter: one shared programme-owned source parameter; independent coordinate/phase projections are not substitutes
input_authority.canonical_geometry: MC-003 canonical bytes and qualified MC-018..023 sweep evidence
input_authority.body_identity: durable body_id/lineage_id from canonical journal; backend topology identifiers are not authority

classifier.algebraic: exact rational polynomial evaluation, multiplicity by exact derivatives, and square-free Sturm root exclusion
classifier.interval_rule: MC032-A returns a sign only when exact evidence proves the open interval root-free and neither endpoint is zero
classifier.critical_routing: exact-zero or interior-root boxes route to MC032-B

analytic_route.separated: accept only an independently certified interval excluding zero
analytic_route.transversal: accept only unique-root evidence with a strict positive certified derivative lower bound on the same source parameter

topology.bounded_event_certificate: MC-032 may certify a critical connectivity event fact when independent event and connectivity evidence exists; it does not itself commit the durable body transition

protected_semantics: canonical journal remains durable source of intent
durable body_id and lineage_id are independent of backend topology
timeouts/resource refusals are terminal evidence states, not fallback truth
